new_constructors.meaning: The exact source connection between two independently acquired disposal actions and the trigger branch it governs.

new_constructors.meaning: The typed, source-bounded disposal exception scope for one local disposal scope, with its exact qualifying clauses.

rationale: 本次修复只改来源获取与组合层：保留有来源依据的 incoming roots，并依据实际条款删除把“请求时返还”错误扩成“请求时返还或销毁”的旧根。新来源程序分别获取动作、动作专属触发、连接关系、例外、责任主体、引用、披露角色及联合条件；de42 的三个月未建立关系分支与随时请求分支分别保留，6fce 的请求返还、项目结束后销毁、书面要求期限、协议终止、备份/法务副本例外和关联方代履行关系也分别保留。G 通过共享 scope/action identity 实际连接这些原子，且所有新 Norm 都由 renderer 产生并以 support_from_terms 汇集完整证据；来源阶段不新增完整政策 Norm。Section 5 引用被显式保留，其尚未展开的责任细节进入 unresolved。有限词法读取不构成完整英文语义或跨来源泛化证明，也不主张 U 学习。

def apply(inputs,premises):
    spans=[]
    by_id={}
    for span in inputs.get('source_spans',[]):
        if isinstance(span,dict):
            spans.append(span)
            by_id[span.get('id')]=span.get('text','')
    old=inputs.get('source_output',{})
    statements=[]
    unresolved=[]
    complete=False
    if isinstance(old,dict):
        complete=bool(old.get('complete',False))
        for row in old.get('statements',[]):
            if isinstance(row,dict) and not source_false_mixed_request_root(row,by_id):
                source_add(statements,row.get('term'),row.get('support_ids',[]))
        for item in old.get('unresolved',[]):
            if isinstance(item,str) and item not in unresolved:
                unresolved.append(item)
    i=0
    while i<len(spans):
        uid=spans[i].get('id')
        raw=spans[i].get('text','')
        if not isinstance(raw,str):
            raw=str(raw)
        text=source_low(raw)
        if 'provided that the recipient has a written agreement' in text and 'may disclose the confidential information to' in text:
            j=source_find_after(spans,i,['strict need to know the contents of the confidential information'],4)
            if j>=0:
                child=spans[j]
                cuid=child.get('id')
                craw=child.get('text','')
                if not isinstance(craw,str):
                    craw=str(craw)
                scope='disclosure|'+raw
                actor=['receiving_party']
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_scope_atom_v4',scope,actor,raw],[uid])
                direct=['receiving_party']
                controlled=['controlled_entities_of',['receiving_party']]
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_recipient_atom_v4',scope,['employees_of',direct],'employee',craw],[cuid])
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_recipient_atom_v4',scope,['officers_of',direct],'official',craw],[cuid])
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_recipient_atom_v4',scope,['agents_of',direct],'agent',craw],[cuid])
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_recipient_atom_v4',scope,['employees_of',controlled],'controlled_employee',craw],[cuid])
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_recipient_atom_v4',scope,['officers_of',controlled],'controlled_official',craw],[cuid])
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_recipient_atom_v4',scope,['agents_of',controlled],'controlled_agent',craw],[cuid])
                condition=['acquired_disclosure_condition_v4','required','not_stated','written_required',craw,raw]
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_condition_atom_v4',scope,condition,craw,raw],[uid,cuid])
        if 'except its employees, officers, directors, independent consultants, affiliates, subsidiaries and other agents' in text and 'confidential information' in text:
            j=source_find_after(spans,i,['bound in writing under terms no less stringent'],3)
            if j>=0:
                qspan=spans[j]
                quid=qspan.get('id')
                qraw=qspan.get('text','')
                if not isinstance(qraw,str):
                    qraw=str(qraw)
                scope='disclosure|'+raw
                actor=['receiving_party']
                owner=['receiving_party']
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_scope_atom_v4',scope,actor,raw],[uid])
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_recipient_atom_v4',scope,['employees_of',owner],'employee',raw],[uid])
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_recipient_atom_v4',scope,['officers_of',owner],'officer',raw],[uid])
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_recipient_atom_v4',scope,['directors_of',owner],'director',raw],[uid])
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_recipient_atom_v4',scope,['consultants_of',owner],'consultant',raw],[uid])
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_recipient_atom_v4',scope,['controlled_entities_of',owner],'affiliate_or_subsidiary',raw],[uid])
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_recipient_atom_v4',scope,['agents_of',owner],'agent',raw],[uid])
                condition=['acquired_disclosure_condition_v4','not_stated','required','written_required',raw,qraw]
                source_add(statements,['source_disclosure_condition_atom_v4',scope,condition,raw,qraw],[uid,quid])
        if 'all confidential information in any form and any medium, including all copies thereof' in text and 'shall be returned' in text and 'or destroyed' in text:
            scope='disposal|'+raw
            rid=scope+'|return'
            did=scope+'|destroy'
            material=source_material(True,False)
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_action_atom_v4',scope,rid,'return',['return_to',material,['disclosing_party']],raw],[uid])
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_action_atom_v4',scope,did,'destroy',['destroy',material],raw],[uid])
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_exception_atom_v4',scope,['acquired_exception_scope_v3','no_acquired_exception','',''],'',''],[uid])
            j=source_find_after(spans,i,['business relationship is not entered'],3)
            if j>=0:
                traw=spans[j].get('text','')
                if not isinstance(traw,str):
                    traw=str(traw)
                branch=scope+'|nonformation'
                trigger=['source_local_trigger','relationship_nonformation_deadline',traw]
                source_add(statements,['source_disposal_trigger_atom_v4',scope,branch,trigger,traw],[spans[j].get('id')])
                source_add(statements,['source_disposal_connector_atom_v4',scope,branch,rid,did,'or',raw],[uid])
            j=source_find_after(spans,i,['promptly upon request'],3)
            if j>=0:
                traw=spans[j].get('text','')
                if not isinstance(traw,str):
                    traw=str(traw)
                branch=scope+'|request'
                trigger=['source_local_trigger','request',traw]
                source_add(statements,['source_disposal_trigger_atom_v4',scope,branch,trigger,traw],[spans[j].get('id')])
                source_add(statements,['source_disposal_connector_atom_v4',scope,branch,rid,did,'or',raw],[uid])
        if 'returned to the disclosing party upon request or destroyed within ten' in text and 'project' in text:
            scope='disposal|'+raw
            rid=scope+'|return'
            did=scope+'|destroy'
            material=source_material(True,False)
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_action_atom_v4',scope,rid,'return',['return_to',material,['disclosing_party']],raw],[uid])
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_action_atom_v4',scope,did,'destroy',['destroy',material],raw],[uid])
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_trigger_atom_v4',scope,rid,['source_local_trigger','request',raw],raw],[uid])
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_trigger_atom_v4',scope,did,['source_local_trigger','project_end_ten_business_days',raw],raw],[uid])
            ex=source_exception_after(spans,i,3)
            exids=ex[3] if ex[3] else [uid]
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_exception_atom_v4',scope,['acquired_exception_scope_v3',ex[0],ex[1],ex[2]],ex[1],ex[2]],exids)
        if 'upon written demand by the disclosing party or upon termination of this confidentiality agreement' in text or 'upon written demand by the disclosing party or upon termination of the agreement' in text:
            j=source_find_after(spans,i,['return the confidential information and all copies, notes or extracts'],3)
            if j>=0:
                child=spans[j]
                cuid=child.get('id')
                craw=child.get('text','')
                if not isinstance(craw,str):
                    craw=str(craw)
                scope='disposal|'+raw
                aid=scope+'|return'
                material=source_material(True,True)
                source_add(statements,['source_disposal_action_atom_v4',scope,aid,'return',['return_to',material,['disclosing_party']],craw],[cuid])
                source_add(statements,['source_disposal_trigger_atom_v4',scope,aid,['source_local_trigger','request_ten_business_days_after_receipt',raw+' '+craw],raw+' '+craw],[uid,cuid])
                source_add(statements,['source_disposal_trigger_atom_v4',scope,aid,['source_local_trigger','agreement_end',raw],raw],[uid])
                ex=source_exception_after(spans,i,6)
                exids=ex[3] if ex[3] else [uid]
                source_add(statements,['source_disposal_exception_atom_v4',scope,['acquired_exception_scope_v3',ex[0],ex[1],ex[2]],ex[1],ex[2]],exids)
        if 'shall cause such corporate affiliate to return or destroy all confidential information' in text and 'in accordance with section' in text:
            scope='disposal|'+raw
            rid=scope+'|return'
            did=scope+'|destroy'
            branch=scope+'|request_before_exit'
            material=source_material(False,False)
            actor=['receiving_party']
            target=['controlled_entities_of',['receiving_party']]
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_duty_atom_v4',scope,actor,target,raw],[uid])
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_action_atom_v4',scope,rid,'return',['return_to',material,['disclosing_party']],raw],[uid])
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_action_atom_v4',scope,did,'destroy',['destroy',material],raw],[uid])
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_connector_atom_v4',scope,branch,rid,did,'cause_or',raw],[uid])
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_trigger_atom_v4',scope,branch,['request_before_affiliate_exit_v4',raw],raw],[uid])
            source_add(statements,['source_reference_atom_v4',scope,raw,raw],[uid])
            source_add(statements,['source_disposal_exception_atom_v4',scope,['acquired_exception_scope_v3','no_acquired_exception','',''],'',''],[uid])
            message='Referenced disposal details remain unresolved for a source-local affiliate duty'
            if message not in unresolved:
                unresolved.append(message)
        if ('back-up/archival' in text or 'backup/archival' in text) and 'not be required to delete' in text:
            scope='retention|'+raw
            material=['acquired_material_v3','backup_archival_copies',raw]
            condition=['acquired_retention_condition_v3','backup_or_archive','continuing_confidentiality_and_source_access_limits',raw]
            source_add(statements,['source_retention_atom_v4',scope,material,condition,raw],[uid])
        if 'single copy of all confidential information may be retained' in text and 'legal department' in text and 'dispute resolution' in text:
            scope='retention|'+raw
            material=['acquired_material_v3','single_copy_all_confidential_information',raw]
            condition=['acquired_retention_condition_v3','dispute_resolution_record','legal_department_only_and_continuing_confidentiality',raw]
            source_add(statements,['source_retention_atom_v4',scope,material,condition,raw],[uid])
        i+=1
    return {'statements':statements,'complete':complete and len(unresolved)==0,'unresolved':source_unique(unresolved)}
